nodes.label: Website Project Management and Reporting Platform
nodes.norm_label: website project management and reporting platform

nodes.label: Build Assignment Model
nodes.rationale: Template-based WordPress builds are assigned to Barry, while custom builds are assigned to Clive, preserving their separate responsibilities.

nodes.label: Human Approval for Consequential Actions
nodes.rationale: Launch, migration, destructive resets, and deletion require human approval because they are consequential actions.

nodes.label: Managed Deployment Followed by User-Owned Infrastructure
nodes.rationale: The application starts with a managed deployment while retaining a path to later infrastructure ownership by the user.
nodes.norm_label: managed deployment followed by user-owned infrastructure

nodes.label: Operational Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: SpyderWeb is designated as the authoritative system for project information and build status.

nodes.label: Safe Simulated WordPress and Template Actions
nodes.rationale: The preview simulates WordPress and template actions because no live server changes are connected yet.
nodes.norm_label: safe simulated wordpress and template actions
